canonical_project: AWS Hinds County / former Delphi campus conversion
aliases: AWS Hinds County / former Delphi campus conversion

location.site_note: Former Delphi manufacturing facility / former Milwaukee Tool site in the Clinton Industrial Park.

status_as_of_cutoff: approved-permitted: City of Clinton minutes show conditional use/dimensional variance approval and FILOT authorization for the 1001 Industrial Park Drive data-center project on 2026-01-15; Mississippi DEQ lists construction stormwater coverage MSR109732 for Alston Construction Company, Inc., Project Delphi/Project Atlas, issued 2026-05-14 and effective through 2027-01-31. City, MDA, and Amazon announcements confirm a planned $1 billion AWS retrofit of the former Delphi facility. No official MW capacity, certificate of occupancy, energization, or live-service record was located.

actions.government_body: City of Clinton Mayor and Board of Aldermen
actions.result_status: The Board approved a conditional use and dimensional variance for the property located at 1001 Industrial Park Blvd/Drive.
actions.access_caveat: Official city minutes; the visible minutes do not identify AWS by name in the land-use item.
actions.evidence_note: Local land-use approval for the site, separate from later public AWS confirmation.

actions.government_body: City of Clinton Mayor and Board of Aldermen
actions.result_status: The Board approved entering into and authorizing the mayor to execute a fee-in-lieu-of-ad-valorem-tax agreement for the property and project at 1001 Industrial Park Blvd/Drive; the attached resolution describes a data center project with at least $750 million capital investment and at least 50 new full-time jobs, subject to Mississippi Development Authority execution of final approval.
actions.access_caveat: Company identity was confidential in the January city resolution; later city/state/company announcements identify AWS/Amazon.
actions.evidence_note: Local incentive authorization and minimum project scale; superseded in public announcements by the $1 billion AWS figure.

actions.result_status: MDA announced Amazon's planned $1 billion project in Clinton to retrofit the former Delphi Corporation plant and create 100 jobs; MDA also said Hinds County and the City of Clinton are assisting.
actions.access_caveat: State announcement is not a building permit, CO, or energization record.

actions.result_status: Amazon announced a $1 billion investment in Hinds County to transform the former Delphi manufacturing plant into a data center facility.
actions.access_caveat: Company announcement; no MW capacity, construction permit, or operating date is published.
actions.evidence_note: Company confirmation of project sponsor and investment scale.

actions.result_status: MDEQ enSearch lists AI ID 90111 for Alston Construction Company, Inc., Project Delphi, Project Atlas at 1001 Industrial Park Drive, Clinton; Construction Modification coverage MSR109732 was issued on 2026-05-14, with permit start 2026-01-21 and end 2027-01-31.
actions.access_caveat: MDEQ says enSearch is informational and not a legal substitute for official administrative files; stormwater coverage is environmental/construction coverage, not a building permit, CO, or energization record.
actions.evidence_note: State permit coverage supports approved/permitted status for site/construction activity.

actions.result_status: City announced a $1 billion AWS investment to transform the long-vacant former Delphi manufacturing facility into a data center; at full operation the facility is expected to support at least 100 highly skilled positions.
actions.access_caveat: Ceremonial/local announcement; no MW capacity, CO, energization, or live-service proof is published.
actions.evidence_note: Official local confirmation of AWS identity, investment amount, retrofit scope, and expected jobs.

sources.match_reason: Seed-only record independently confirmed by City of Clinton minutes, MDEQ construction stormwater coverage, MDA announcement, City of Clinton AWS announcement, and Amazon announcement.

history.new_value: approved-permitted based on local conditional-use/variance/FILOT approvals plus MDEQ construction stormwater coverage; no CO, energization, or live-service evidence found.

history.note: No official MW capacity figure located; third-party/non-primary estimates were not adopted.
